title: 交通事故
description: 交通事故現場的溝通用語

sentences.en: There has been a serious car accident at the intersection ahead, and it looks like at least two people are trapped inside the damaged vehicle.
sentences.zh: 前方路口發生了嚴重的車禍，看起來至少有兩個人被困在受損的車輛裡。

sentences.en: I was rear-ended by a truck while waiting at the red light, and although I am not seriously injured, my neck and back are very sore.
sentences.zh: 我在等紅燈時被卡車追撞了，雖然沒有嚴重受傷，但我的脖子和背非常疼。

sentences.en: Could you please call an ambulance for the motorcyclist who was hit by the car turning left, because he is lying on the road and not moving?
sentences.zh: 能否請你幫被左轉車撞到的機車騎士叫救護車？他躺在路上一動不動。

sentences.en: The driver of the other vehicle, who ran the red light and caused the collision, is refusing to exchange insurance information with me.
sentences.zh: 另一輛車的駕駛闖紅燈造成了碰撞，卻拒絕和我交換保險資訊。

sentences.en: I need to document the damage to both vehicles by taking photographs before we move the cars out of the traffic lane.
sentences.zh: 在我們把車移出車道之前，我需要拍照記錄兩輛車的損壞情況。

sentences.en: A pedestrian was struck by a speeding car while crossing the street at the designated crosswalk, and bystanders are now attempting to help her.
sentences.zh: 一位行人在指定的行人穿越道過馬路時被超速的車撞了，旁觀者正在試圖幫助她。

sentences.en: The accident caused a fuel leak from the overturned vehicle, and I think everyone should move away from the scene until the fire department arrives.
sentences.zh: 事故導致翻覆車輛漏油，我認為在消防隊到達之前所有人都應該遠離現場。

sentences.en: I was cycling in the designated bike lane when a car door suddenly opened in front of me, causing me to crash and injure my shoulder.
sentences.zh: 我在指定的自行車道上騎車時，一扇車門突然在我面前打開，導致我撞上去傷了肩膀。

sentences.en: The taxi I was riding in collided with another vehicle at the roundabout, and I hit my head on the window during the impact.
sentences.zh: 我搭的計程車在圓環和另一輛車相撞了，撞擊時我的頭撞上了車窗。

sentences.en: Several witnesses who saw the accident happen are willing to provide their contact information and testify about what they observed.
sentences.zh: 幾位目擊事故發生的證人願意提供聯絡資訊並為他們所見作證。

sentences.en: The road is completely blocked because of a multi-car pileup that happened during the heavy rainstorm, and traffic is being diverted to side streets.
sentences.zh: 因為大暴雨時發生的連環車禍，道路完全被阻塞，車輛正被引導到小路。

sentences.en: I need a police officer to come to the scene and write an official accident report, which my rental car company requires before they will process any claims.
sentences.zh: 我需要警察到現場寫一份正式的事故報告，我的租車公司在處理任何理賠前都需要這份報告。

sentences.en: The bus driver lost control of the vehicle after swerving to avoid a dog on the road, and the bus slid into a concrete barrier on the side.
sentences.zh: 公車司機為了閃避路上的狗而失控，公車滑向路邊的水泥護欄。

sentences.en: My car has been hit while it was parked on the street, and the person responsible drove away without leaving any contact information or a note.
sentences.zh: 我的車停在路邊被撞了，肇事者開走了，沒有留下任何聯絡資訊或字條。

sentences.en: Please do not move the injured person until the paramedics arrive, because moving someone with a possible spinal injury could make the situation much worse.
sentences.zh: 請在救護人員到達前不要移動傷者，因為移動可能有脊椎傷害的人會讓情況更糟。

sentences.en: I have dashcam footage that clearly shows the other driver running through the stop sign and hitting my car on the passenger side.
sentences.zh: 我有行車記錄器畫面清楚顯示另一位駕駛闖了停車標誌並撞上我車的副駕駛側。

sentences.en: The child who was in the back seat of the car at the time of the accident appears to be in shock, although she does not have any visible injuries.
sentences.zh: 事故發生時坐在後座的孩子似乎處於驚嚇狀態，雖然她沒有任何明顯的外傷。

sentences.en: After the collision, both drivers pulled over to the side of the road to assess the damage and wait for the police to arrive at the scene.
sentences.zh: 碰撞後，兩位駕駛都靠邊停車，評估損壞情況並等待警察到達現場。

sentences.en: I would like to know the procedure for filing an insurance claim in this country, since the accident was clearly caused by the other party's negligence.
sentences.zh: 我想了解在這個國家申請保險理賠的程序，因為事故顯然是由對方的疏忽造成的。

sentences.en: The airbags deployed on impact, which probably saved my life, but the force of the deployment left burns and bruises on my arms and chest.
sentences.zh: 安全氣囊在撞擊時彈開了，可能救了我一命，但彈開的力道在我手臂和胸口留下了燒傷和瘀青。

sentences.en: A large truck carrying construction materials overturned on the highway, scattering debris across all lanes and making it impossible for vehicles to pass safely.
sentences.zh: 一輛載著建材的大卡車在高速公路上翻覆，碎片散落在所有車道上，車輛無法安全通過。

sentences.en: The elderly woman who was crossing the street told the officer that she did not see the car approaching because it had no headlights on.
sentences.zh: 正在過馬路的老婦人告訴警員她沒有看到車子靠近，因為車子沒有開大燈。

sentences.en: I am shaking badly and cannot think clearly after the accident, so could someone please help me contact my family and let them know what happened?
sentences.zh: 車禍後我抖得很厲害而且無法清楚思考，能不能有人幫我聯繫家人告訴他們發生了什麼？

sentences.en: The scooter rider who caused the accident by cutting in front of my car fled the scene immediately, but I managed to memorize his license plate number.
sentences.zh: 騎機車的人切到我車前面造成了事故後立即逃離現場，但我設法記住了他的車牌號碼。

sentences.en: Both lanes of the bridge are closed due to a collision between a delivery van and a sedan, and emergency services are currently working to clear the wreckage.
sentences.zh: 橋上兩個車道因為送貨車和轎車的碰撞而封閉，急救服務人員目前正在清理殘骸。

sentences.en: I think we should set up warning triangles behind our vehicles to alert other drivers, since this curve has very poor visibility for approaching traffic.
sentences.zh: 我認為我們應該在車後擺放警告三角標誌來提醒其他駕駛，因為這個彎道對來車的能見度很差。

sentences.en: The tow truck that was called to remove the damaged vehicles from the road should arrive within the next twenty minutes, according to the dispatcher.
sentences.zh: 根據調度員的說法，被叫來把受損車輛從路上拖走的拖車應該在二十分鐘內到達。

sentences.en: After exchanging insurance details with the other driver, I realized that his policy had expired two months ago, which complicates the situation significantly.
sentences.zh: 和另一位駕駛交換保險資料後，我發現他的保單兩個月前就過期了，這讓情況變得複雜許多。

sentences.en: The paramedic who examined me at the scene recommended that I go to the hospital for X-rays, because there might be fractures that are not immediately visible.
sentences.zh: 在現場檢查我的急救人員建議我去醫院照X光，因為可能有一些不是立即可見的骨折。

sentences.en: I was a passenger in the vehicle that was involved in the accident, and I would like to make a separate statement about what I observed during the crash.
sentences.zh: 我是事故車輛中的乘客，我想就碰撞期間我所觀察到的情況做一份單獨的陳述。
